capability: J2/von Mises elastoplasticity in a thick cylinder

quantity.name: full-plastic-collapse internal pressure
quantity.observable: Applied internal pressure at the first load step for which the effective plastic strain is nonzero on the outer radius r=b. Full-section yield is the definition of plastic collapse for this problem, so this is a direct measurement of p_lim and not a threshold proxy.
quantity.supersedes: The previous observable was the first pressure with max effective plastic strain >= 1, an arbitrary operational threshold. Replaced 2026-08-03 before the runs below.

reference.source: Von Mises plane-strain thick-cylinder solution: p_y=(sigma_y/sqrt(3))(1-a^2/b^2); p(c)=(sigma_y/sqrt(3))[2 ln(c/a)+1-c^2/b^2]; p_lim=(2 sigma_y/sqrt(3)) ln(b/a).
reference.confirmed_from: Evaluated symbolically and numerically for a=1 m, b=2 m, sigma_y=100 MPa.

fully_plastic_stress_field.derivation: Equilibrium dsigma_rr/dr = (sigma_tt-sigma_rr)/r with the plane-strain von Mises condition sigma_tt-sigma_rr = 2*sigma_y/sqrt(3) = k, integrated under the traction-free outer wall sigma_rr(b)=0. Setting sigma_rr(a) = -p recovers p_lim = k*ln(b/a).

tolerance.metric: relative error in p_lim; p_y, p(c) and the fully-plastic stress field are secondary checks
tolerance.rationale: Two percent covers the moving plastic-front mesh and pressure-step discretization; it is not widened after observing the answer.

measurement_resolution.requirement: The load increment must be at most 0.005*p_lim, so that the measurement is at least four times finer than the declared 2% tolerance. Declared in response to review finding F2, where a 2 MPa increment (2.5% of p_lim) made the row structurally unable to fail.
measurement_resolution.step_independence: Halving the increment must move the measured p_lim by less than the 2% tolerance.

fully_plastic_stress_profile.metric: L2 norm of the sigma_rr and sigma_tt profile error at the collapse step, normalized by k = 2*sigma_y/sqrt(3)
fully_plastic_stress_profile.rationale: Declared before the runs. This is the resolved component-wise stress plateau whose absence kept the case PARTIAL; 2% matches the primary tolerance and covers constant-monomial element sampling of a logarithmic profile.

convergence.note: p_lim is a limit load, not a pointwise field value, and dp/dc vanishes as the front reaches the outer wall. No spatial convergence order is claimed for it; mesh independence is reported instead.
